No front door

Listeners stay listeners

Someone can enjoy your podcast and your posts for a year and never join an email list. Every week without a class capturing emails is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

Every enquiry starts from zero

A follower can go from one post to asking about private work with no idea how you teach. A class lets people experience your approach first, so the ones who apply already trust it.

Content treadmill

1,833 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post and the next episode. When you take a week off to rest or read, the enquiries take a week off too.

The people who love your content but aren't ready for private work today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A free masterclass that sells your book and fills your private coaching

You already have the audience and a low-ticket product. What's missing is one free 60-minute class that teaches your approach, offers Get Your Vibe Back on the thank-you page, and invites the right people to apply for private coaching or a mentorship assessment. Meta ads then put that class in front of new people every day.

Audience + Meta ads40.1k on Instagram, your podcast listeners, and new people reached by ads

Fixes the missing front door

One free class becomes the link in your bio, the call to action at the end of each podcast episode, and the destination for your ads. Every sign-up is an email you own.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page invites people who want to go deeper to apply. You only talk to people who watched, stayed and told you what they're looking for.

Puts your book to work

Get Your Vibe Back is offered at the exact moment people are most inspired, on the thank-you page, instead of waiting in a link list. It helps pay for the ads.

The 95%*

Not ready for private work yet

They join the free class, pick up your book from the thank-you page, and keep learning from your emails and your podcast. They pay you while they build trust.

The qualified 5%

Ready to go deeper

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page for private manifesting coaching or a psychic mentorship assessment. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails warm them up.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The vibe drain nobody talks about"

Hook
"As a psychic medium, here's the energy drain I notice most, and almost nobody talks about it." (to camera, warm light, the same look as your profile)
Body
"It isn't one big event. It's the small stuff: the thoughts you replay, the conversations you dread, the clutter you walk past every day. Each one takes a little energy, and together they can leave you feeling flat." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach how to clear them in a free 60-minute class called The Vibe Reset. Tap Sign up to save your seat."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before you trust a gut feeling"

Hook
"Before you act on a gut feeling, ask yourself these three questions." (Carla holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: is it calm, or is it urgent? Two: does it repeat quietly, or does it spiral? Three: does it feel like expansion, or like fear? Intuition and worry feel different once you know what to listen for." (caption for each question)
CTA
"I go deeper on this in my free masterclass. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"People ask me whether to start with my book, my podcast or private coaching. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"If you're new here, don't pick yet. Come to my free class first. You'll learn how I think about energy, intuition and manifesting, try a few practices that week, and know which next step feels right."
CTA
"It's called The Vibe Reset, it's free, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
